info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Payments-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Payments API provides access to detailed information regarding payments linked to education enrollments. This API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of payment records associated with various educational programs. Ideal for educational institutions and administrators, the API supports the management of enrollment financial data, helping streamline processes related to tuition and other fees. Typical consumers include finance teams and enrollment services looking to monitor and report on payment statuses and trends.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed payment information associated with their enrollments. It is designed to help users understand their payment status, history, and further details regarding their transactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a payment related to enrollments. This should include the necessary payment information formatted as JSON according to the specified schema.
